Anita (CS): quick share — small customer-facing runbook we gave to Acme yesterday to reduce streaming latency spikes during onboarding. TL;DR: send-side warm handshake, short batching hints, and an explicit feedback microform for renewal-risk signals. link: https://redwood-internal/handbooks/cs/runbooks/streaming-warmups :sparkles:
Sam H: nice, can you paste the minimal steps here? want something we can hand to AMs in 5 bullets
Anita (CS): sure — boiled down to 5 steps:
1) opt-in warm handshake: client sets header `X-RW-WARM: 1` for the first 3 requests to trigger quick KV cache materialization
2) short-lived prefix cache (ttl 30s) keyed by tenant+prompt-hash for common templates
3) batching hint: client may add `batch_hint: 0.05` (seconds) to allow 50ms micro-batching in our edge router
4) streaming keepalive: send a 1-byte noop every 2s during quiet input to avoid idle eviction
5) feedback ping: after session complete, show a 1-question microform (quality 1-5) that calls our feedback webhook
Jordan M: two notes on privacy/consent — add an explicit checkbox in the trial UI for "participate in pre-warm optimization" and log the consent event. we store only the minimal metadata (tenant_id, consent_ts). :white_check_mark:
Sam H: for renewal-risk tracking, which feedback thresholds should we care about? low effort for AMs plz
Anita (CS): we recommended a quick rule: if average session rating <= 3 AND session drop rate rises > 12% in 7 days, flag as "engage-now" for AM. Also auto-create a CS ticket if customer has >3 negative feedbacks in 14d. kept it binary to avoid noise.
Leo (SRE): ops checklist additions:
- monitor prefix cache hit ratio per tenant (alert if < 40%)
- track mean first-byte latency for warmed vs cold (expect warmed < 120ms)
- cap batch window at 100ms for latency-sensitive tiers
- disable noop keepalive for air-gapped/private deployments unless customer approves
- sample 1% of sessions for full KV dump for debugging (scrubbed)
cs-bot: [AUTO] Added runbook artifact to /cs-runbooks/streaming-warmups/v1 and created ticket RW-6872 for onboarding checklist sync
Sam H: love the binary thresholds. can we make an AM one-pager from this? maybe add 2 example scripts they can paste into Postman
Anita (CS): yes — I'll draft a one-pager + two Postman snippets (warm handshake + feedback webhook) and ping you. ETA EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
Jordan M: small code snippet for the warm header (for AMs to paste):
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-RW-WARM: 1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-medium",
  "input": "<starter prompt>",
  "batch_hint": 0.05
}
```
Anita (CS): thanks all. next step: I'll loop in Solutions to schedule a 20m show-and-tell with the customer if they hit the engage-now flag. cc @Sam H to coordinate timing. :+1:
Sam H: on it, will prep AM notes and share calendar slots tomorrow.
